value.answer: Honda Odyssey, I'd say. U.S. News has it #1 with a 9.3 out of 10, Kelley Blue Book lists it #1 too, and Car Talk's staff picked it. Edmunds says it's the minivan they most like to drive. If gas mileage matters most, the Toyota Sienna gets 36 mpg combined. The rankings don't fully agree, so that's my take.
